meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 安装了此技能后,Claude 会对比当前代码与最新已发布的 npm 版本,读取真实 diff,按三个发布层列出未发布的变更,并给出各层及整体的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed”等关键词,或询问未发布变更时触发。

say.note: Claude 会对比 git 与已发布版本并输出分析。
按发布层生成变更清单和版本号建议。
触发未发布变更的差异分析。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude compares the current code against the latest published npm versions, reads the actual diffs, lists unpublished changes by three release layers, and recommends version bumps per layer and overall.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "unpublished changes", "changelog", "what changed", or similar keywords asking about unreleased changes.

say_en.note: Claude compares git with published versions and outputs the analysis.
Generates a layered change list and version recommendations.
Triggers diff analysis of unpublished changes.
